properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for verifying the lifecycle of SSL Certificates is properly managed
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to verify the lifecycle of SSL certificates is properly managed to mitigate the risks of certificate validity and weak encryption algorithms as per Caelum Cryptography standard.
